test_assert_eq: test the assert_eq function to verify two values are equal with a descriptive error message
test_assert_neq: test the assert_neq function to verify two values are not equal with a descriptive error message
test_assert_lt: test the assert_lt function to verify a real value is less than an expected threshold
test_assert_tensor_eq: test the assert_tensor_eq function to compare two PyTorch tensors for approximate equality within a tolerance
test_assert_zero_grads: test the assert_zero_grads function to verify all parameter gradients sum to zero
